The Fortis story
Ambitious businesses need more than isolated services.

Strategy, design, code and marketing only work when they are built as one. That idea shaped every project before it became a company.

  1. 01
    The belief

    Strategy, creative thinking, technology and execution should work together, not sit in separate hands that never meet.

  2. 02
    The proof

    5+ years and 120+ projects for clients worldwide, from Bangladesh government platforms like BMET and the e-Passport website to work with Digital Dropouts, Code2Product and CodeMaster.io.

  3. 03
    The promise

    FORTIS is the next stage of that work: one team that takes a business from idea to execution, from execution to growth, and from manual operations to intelligent systems.
